title: Port of CAW Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutPort of CAW ~ 89 Seaward Drive ~ Santa Rosa Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 20% Discount off thru Summer 2026! 4-night minimum (excludes June 27-July 4 and July 4-11) with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 8th. Discount is reflected in online pricing. Port of CAW is a warm, family friendly Gulf front home located in the gated Sunrise Beach subdivision next to Gulf Place. With 3,168sq of living (2,069 interior), Port of CAW sleeps up to 6 guests and offers 3 bedrooms, 3 baths, two Gulf front porches, parking for 2 cars ONLY (driveway parking only; no garage access to guests), Wi-Fi, grilling deck, private boardwalk to beach and a short walk to the delightful restaurants, eclectic shops and colorful galleries of local 30A artists in Gulf Place. Daily beach service set-up (4 chairs, 2 umbrellas) is included with your rental! PLEASE NOTE - On-street parking is prohibited in the neighborhood. Fireplaces in living room and master bedroom are decorative only and not for guest use. While golf carts are allowed, they must be parked in the driveway ONLY and counts as one vehicle toward parking maximum. For a special treat, utilize your Beach Gear credit toward the rentals of bikes and ride along the Timpoochee Trail, paralleling the entire length of 30A through our beach side communities. Second Floor: Entrance into house. 1 bedroom. 1 bath. Living room. Dining table seats 6. Island seating for 4. Fully equipped kitchen. Gulf front covered porch. #1 Bedroom has a Queen bed Full bath, with tub/shower Third Floor: 2 Gulf front bedrooms. 2 baths. Laundry. Gulf front covered porch. #2 En-Suite Bedroom has 2 double beds, tub/shower, Gulf front porch access #3 En-Suite (Master) Bedroom has a King bed, sitting area, soaking tub, walk-in shower, separate vanities, water closet, Gulf front porch access Amenities: Business Features Hi Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 3 Flat Screen TVs, 1 DVD player, board games, puzzles, books Distinctive Features Gulf front with expansive Gulf views Gated neighborhood Daily beach service included (2 chairs, 1 umbrella) Bed, bath, kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Driveway parking for 2 cars ONLY (no garage access, no on-street parking allowed) 1 King bed, 1 Queen bed, 2 Double beds 3 full bathrooms, 2 gas fireplaces, iron, ironing board, 3 hair dryers, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, outdoor shower, outdoor Gulf front porches with expansive views, porch furniture. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, farmhouse sink, coffee maker, electric range, French door refrigerator with ice maker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, washer, dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Seaside (6 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
